passages.text: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto appearing elsewhere in this report. In addition to historical consolidated financial information, the following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties, and assumptions. Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated by these forward-looking statements as a result of many factors. We discuss factors that we believe could cause or contribute to these differences below and elsewhere in this report, including those set forth under “Risk Factors” and “Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements.” Overview Veeva is the leading provider of industry cloud solutions for the global life sciences industry. Our offerings span cloud software, data, and business consulting and are designed to meet the unique needs of our customers and their most strategic business functions—from research and development (“R&D”) through commercialization. Our solutions help life sciences companies develop and bring products to market faster and more efficiently, market and sell more effectively, and maintain compliance with government regulations. Our industry cloud solutions are grouped into four major product categories—Veeva Development Cloud, Veeva Quality Cloud, Veeva Commercial Cloud, and Veeva Data Cloud. For financial reporting purposes, “Commercial Solutions” revenues refer to revenues associated with our Veeva Commercial Cloud and Veeva Data Cloud solutions, and “R&D and Quality Solutions” revenues refer to revenues associated with our Veeva Development Cloud and Veeva Quality Cloud solutions. In our fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, we derived approximately 47% and 53% of our subscription revenues and 45% and 55% of our total revenues from our Commercial Solutions and R&D and Quality Solutions, respectively. For the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025, we derived approximately 48% and 52% of our subscription revenues and 47% and 53% of our total revenues from our Commercial Solutions and R&D and Quality Solutions, respectively. Revenues associated with our R&D and Quality Solutions are expected to increase as a percentage of both subscription revenues and total revenues in the future. We also offer certain of our R&D and Quality Solutions to industries outside the life sciences industry primarily in North America and Europe. For our fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, our total revenues were $3,195 million, $2,747 million, and $2,364 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth in total revenues of 16% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, and 16% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2025. For our fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, our subscription revenues were $2,684 million, $2,285 million, and $1,902 million, respectively, representing year-over-year growth in subscription revenues of 17% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, and 20% in our fiscal year ended January 31, 2025. credit_strengths.text: Veeva's revenue base is highly recurring, with subscription revenues representing the substantial majority of total revenues and growing at a double-digit pace, while R&D and Quality Solutions are expected to increase as a share of the mix, supporting revenue visibility and pricing resilience through the life sciences demand cycle.

Operating profitability is strong and improving, with operating margin well above the Information Technology sector median and operating income compounding faster than revenue, evidencing operating leverage as the business scales and supporting internal cash generation for debt service and reinvestment.

key_risks.text: The filing's risk-factor and forward-looking passages flag that actual results could differ materially from anticipated outcomes due to risks, uncertainties and assumptions, including competitive position, industry and macroeconomic conditions and product capabilities, which could pressure revenue growth and operating margins relative to our expectations.

No borrowing tags were reported for the balance-sheet date and the debt note must be confirmed, so funded debt may be nil; however, the absence of interest expense and debt tags leaves leverage, coverage and refinancing risk unquantified, and any future debt-funded acquisition or buyback would change the capital structure.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers current liabilities comfortably and the current ratio is well above the sector median, indicating ample near-term liquidity; with no funded debt evidenced, cash flow is available for reinvestment, buybacks and potential acquisitions rather than mandatory debt amortization.

Interest coverage cannot be measured because interest expense is missing and debt is not tagged, a material data gap for assessing servicing capacity; nonetheless, the large cash balance and strong operating cash flow provide a substantial buffer against any future borrowing or lease obligations.

overall_credit_view.text: Veeva presents a strong credit profile: high recurring revenue, sector-leading operating margin, robust operating cash flow and a large net cash position, with no funded debt evidenced; leverage and coverage metrics are unavailable, so the indicative financial risk profile is incomplete rather than adverse.

Our forward view is that cash generation should continue to fund operations, buybacks and potential acquisitions without straining the balance sheet; we would revisit the view if debt-funded M&A or shareholder returns materially reduce the cash buffer or if growth and margins decelerate toward sector norms.

credit_strengths.text: Veeva的收入基礎高度具經常性，訂閱收入佔總收入絕大部分，並以雙位數速度增長，而研發與品質解決方案預計將在組合中佔比上升，支持在生命科學需求週期中的收入可見度與定價韌性。
營運盈利能力強勁且持續改善，營運利潤率遠高於資訊科技行業中位數，營運收入複合增長快於收入，顯示業務規模擴大時帶來營運槓桿，並支持內部現金生成以償還債務及再投資。

key_risks.text: 申報文件的風險因素及前瞻性陳述指出，實際結果可能因風險、不確定性及假設而與預期結果存在重大差異，包括競爭地位、行業及宏觀經濟狀況以及產品能力，這可能對收入增長及營運利潤率構成壓力，使其低於我們的預期。
資產負債表日期並無報告借款標籤，且債務附註必須確認，因此有資金債務可能為零；然而，缺乏利息支出及債務標籤使槓桿、覆蓋率及再融資風險無法量化，而任何未來以債務融資的收購或回購將改變資本結構。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營運現金流輕鬆覆蓋流動負債，流動比率遠高於行業中位數，顯示短期流動性充裕；由於並無有資金債務的證據，現金流可用於再投資、回購及潛在收購，而非強制性債務攤還。
利息覆蓋率無法計量，因為利息支出缺失且債務並無標籤，這是評估償債能力的重大數據缺口；儘管如此，龐大的現金餘額及強勁的營運現金流為任何未來借款或租賃義務提供了可觀的緩衝。

overall_credit_view.text: Veeva呈現強勁的信用狀況：高經常性收入、行業領先的營運利潤率、穩健的營運現金流及龐大的淨現金狀況，且並無有資金債務的證據；槓桿及覆蓋率指標無法取得，因此指示性財務風險狀況不完整而非不利。
我們的前瞻觀點是，現金生成應繼續為營運、回購及潛在收購提供資金，而不會對資產負債表造成壓力；若以債務融資的併購或股東回報大幅減少現金緩衝，或增長及利潤率減速至行業常態，我們將重新審視此觀點。
